setup_cmd: [ -f go.mod ] || go mod init github.com/dustin/go-humanize; go list -test ./... >/dev/null
notes: Tests run via go-test-each (harness/docker/go-test-each.sh, baked into tc-go): every top-level Test/Example runs in its own test-binary process (test2json -> /out/go-test.json, 60s per test) so a panicking sabotage stub only fails the tests that actually reach it. v1.0.0 predates modules: setup_cmd runs `go mod init github.com/dustin/go-humanize` in the workspace copy (stdlib-only, no downloads).
